gaps.sentence: Her ___ (APPOINT) as captain surprised no one.
gaps.explanation: 'Her appointment as captain' — the event of being appointed.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.
The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.
'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.

gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.
